name: Barn
overview: The Bible uses the barn as a symbol of provision, blessing, and divine care. Scriptures such as Proverbs 3:10 and Haggai 2:19 highlight the barn as a place where God’s blessings result in abundance and fruitful harvests. Conversely, passages like Joel 1:17 reveal the consequences of spiritual and physical desolation when barns are broken down and seeds spoiled. Jesus further employs the imagery of barns to illustrate God’s faithful provision (Matthew 6:26) and the final gathering of the righteous (Matthew 13:30), emphasizing both God’s care and His ultimate judgment.
